Plath analyzes the form as an infinitive of an athematic verb, with the infinitive ending ''-hen''; this analysis is supported by Killen, who cites Plath for the demonstration that ''e-re-e'' is athematic. Van Beek, while accepting an athematic ''*-hen'' in Mycenaean, considers the assumption that ''e-re-e'' belonged to an athematic verb questionable.
